zapdos-zap-cannon.name: Zap Cannon
zapdos-zap-cannon.description: Bond skill: an electric blast up to 3 hexes away (Power 100); Paralyzed 1 turn.

zapdos-volt-switch.name: Volt Switch
zapdos-volt-switch.description: Bond skill: a bolt up to 2 hexes away (Power 70), then it slips out of engagement.

zapdos-brave-bird.name: Brave Bird
zapdos-brave-bird.description: Bond skill: a reckless dive into an adjacent foe (Power 100).

zapdos-static.name: Static
zapdos-static.description: Its damaging hits on adjacent foes Paralyze them for 1 turn.

zapdos-storm-feathers.name: Storm Feathers
zapdos-storm-feathers.description: Deals 15% more damage to foes 2+ hexes away.

zapdos-agility.name: Agility
zapdos-agility.description: New skill: relaxes and streamlines its body; it is Hasted for 2 turns.

zapdos-light-screen.name: Light Screen
zapdos-light-screen.description: New skill: a wall of light; it and adjacent allies are Fortified for 2 turns.

zapdos-storm-bringer.name: Storm Bringer
zapdos-storm-bringer.description: Its Electric moves deal 15% more damage.

zapdos-updraft.name: Updraft
zapdos-updraft.description: Rides an updraft away from engaged foes without drawing free strikes.

zapdos-shock-wave.name: Shock Wave
zapdos-shock-wave.description: New skill: a jolt that never misses a foe up to 2 hexes away, even around others (Power 60).

zapdos-pluck.name: Pluck
zapdos-pluck.description: New skill: pecks a foe (Power 65); a knockout with it gives the team 1 Bond.

zapdos-thunder-cloud.name: Thunder Cloud
zapdos-thunder-cloud.description: Statuses it inflicts last 1 turn longer.

zapdos-storm-rider.name: Storm Rider
zapdos-storm-rider.description: Regains 2 movement when it knocks out a foe on its turn.

zapdos-discharge.name: Discharge
zapdos-discharge.description: New skill: lightning bursts from it onto all adjacent foes (Power 85), Paralyzing 1 turn.

zapdos-fly.name: Fly
zapdos-fly.description: New skill: swoops at an adjacent foe (Power 75), then breaks free of engagement.

zapdos-eye-of-the-storm.name: Eye of the Storm
zapdos-eye-of-the-storm.description: Its ranged moves fire over Pokémon standing in the way.

zapdos-grounding-strike.name: Grounding Strike
zapdos-grounding-strike.description: Deals 20% more damage to Paralyzed foes.

zapdos-hurricane.name: Hurricane
zapdos-hurricane.description: New skill: a raging storm wind at a foe up to 2 hexes away (Power 90).

zapdos-sky-drop.name: Sky Drop
zapdos-sky-drop.description: New skill: seizes a foe, carries it aloft and drops it 2 hexes away (Power 85).

zapdos-electric-momentum.name: Electric Momentum
zapdos-electric-momentum.description: Each combo it lands gives the team 1 Bond.

zapdos-overcharge.name: Overcharge
zapdos-overcharge.description: Deals 15% more damage but takes 10% more damage.

zapdos-thunderbird.name: Thunderbird
zapdos-thunderbird.description: Capstone. Its Flying moves deal 25% more; each knockout gives the team 1 Bond.

zapdos-lord-of-thunder.name: Lord of Thunder
zapdos-lord-of-thunder.description: Capstone. A knockout resets its skill cooldowns; deals 20% more damage to full-HP foes.
